improvements: Shorter fronts and dominant top planes now65–69%for4families and64%for lowdock, versus frontal active scene.
Ground carries sparse native1pxgrain; plaster uses restrained irregular light/tan texture instead of flatbrown or a repeated brick-cap motif.

not_approved_or_hidden: The all-terracotta proposal was rejected for losing shipyard identity. Current proposal retains terracotta only on the unionhall; other roofs use the existing fine1pxsteel source with a shared R04/factory10service perimeter.
The steel source has broad blue plate areas with little internal wear. Ridge/eave/caps are preserved, but its material reading still needs visual judgment; no invented noise was added.
Six annexes retain the exact repeated160x128footprint of the active layout. Style changed, route/density did not; repetition still needs editorial judgment.
The union emblem is preserved as an elevated sign crossing the roof/eave above the intact door. Its physical reading should be judged in1x, not accepted from tile metrics.
Native palette normalized to one16-colorRGB333bank. Some source shades merge; no claim of pixel identity to the original reference palette.
No C integration or normal-combat performance claim. Tile count is an atlas result only.
